input.question: How was the NASA mission Magellan able to map the Venusian surface so quickly?
input.ground_truth: Venus’ day is 243 earth days long. Magellan orbited Venus every 3 hours or so. That means that during a single Venusian day, the probe circled the planet almost 2000 times. I don’t know what you mean by quickly, but it took almost an entire earth year to get that 96%, for what it’s worth.
